news_items.title: Multi-statement transactions for Apache Iceberg tables in Amazon Redshift
news_items.summary: Amazon Redshift now supports multi-statement transactions for Apache Iceberg tables, so you can run several DML statements against one Iceberg table inside a single BEGIN…COMMIT and publish them as one atomic Iceberg snapshot. This post explains why one commit per statement makes multi-step pipelines fragile, what you can run in a transaction, and how it performs.
